name: rsa
description: RSA signature verification (RFC 8017): RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 and RSASSA-PSS with MGF1 and a salt of the hash's length, SHA-256, SHA-384 or SHA-512, for moduli of 2048 to 8192 bits and exponents of at most 33 bits, of a digest that names its hash, answering which part is wrong (key, encoding, signature).
